Search / coordinate entry (opens full-screen on focus).
Selected point marker; tap map to move it (confirm toast shows new coordinates).
Domain chips scroll horizontally; non-MVP domains labelled 'later'.
Layers button opens a bottom sheet with toggles, legend and basemap.
Select centre: keyboard and switch-access alternative to tapping.
Collapsed sheet: coordinates, FEMA zone chip, nearest gauge, Ask button (44 px targets).
Half sheet: coordinates header pinned; FEMA and NOAA cards; question box.
Full sheet answer: header shows bound point; Back returns to map without losing the answer.
Claim bullets with citation chips; tap chip expands its source below and moves focus.
Source detail accordion (same fields as desktop).
Follow-up box stays scoped to the same point; moving the point starts a new thread.
